english.title: Fail to comply with the requirements of Part IV of the Act relating to entry of goods on their importation
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person making entry of goods on their importation, failed to comply with the requirements of Part IV of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979 in connection with that entry in that **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF THE CONTRAVENTION..)

(i) On conviction, the goods in question shall be liable to forfeiture.
(ii) This section shall not apply to any failure:-
